chainIdentity.metadata.title: Your identity | 6529 Network
chainIdentity.metadata.description: Your identity on the 6529 Network: handle, profile, wallets, REP and NIC, and fees.
chainIdentity.title: Your identity on the 6529 Network
chainIdentity.intro: Your handle, profile, wallets, REP, NIC and delegations are on the 6529 Network. Each change is a transaction you sign, and it costs a small fee in $fake6529.
chainIdentity.notOpen: Changes on the 6529 Network open here on {date}, when identities have moved there.
chainIdentity.notOpenNoDate: Changes on the 6529 Network open here once identities have moved there.
chainIdentity.connect.body: Connect a wallet to see its identity on the 6529 Network.
chainIdentity.readError: The 6529 Network didn't answer. Try again in a minute.
chainIdentity.summary.heading: Identity
chainIdentity.summary.identityBalanceHin: Fees for your identity's changes come from here.
chainIdentity.summary.walletBalanceHint: Fees for creating an identity, for wallet-only delegations and for moving $fake6529 come from here.
chainIdentity.rating.heading: REP and NIC
chainIdentity.rating.body: Your TDH, {tdh}, is the most REP you can give across everyone, and the most NIC. To give REP or NIC, open the person's profile page.
chainIdentity.rating.bodyNoTdh: Your TDH is the most REP you can give across everyone, and the most NIC. Your TDH can't be read right now, so what is left isn't shown. To give REP or NIC, open the person's profile page.
chainIdentity.create.heading: Create your identity
chainIdentity.create.body: This wallet has no identity on the 6529 Network. Create one and this wallet becomes its first wallet. You can add more wallets later. The fee comes from this wallet's balance.
chainIdentity.create.waiting: This wallet left an identity on {left}. It can create a new one after {until}, and rejoin the one it left at any time.
chainIdentity.handle.heading: Handle
chainIdentity.handle.body: Your handle is your name on 6529.io and on the 6529 Network. A new handle replaces your current one.
chainIdentity.handle.label: New handle
chainIdentity.handle.hint: 3 to 15 characters: a to z, 0 to 9 and _.
chainIdentity.handle.invalid: That isn't a valid handle. Use 3 to 15 characters: a to z, 0 to 9 and _.
chainIdentity.fees.heading: $fake6529 for fees
chainIdentity.fees.body: Each change costs a small fee in $fake6529. 6529 sends $fake6529 once to each wallet and each identity, for free. Your wallet signs a message to ask for it, which costs nothing.
chainIdentity.fees.empty: Your identity has no $fake6529 yet, so it can't pay for changes. Get $fake6529 for this wallet, then move it to your identity.
chainIdentity.fees.dripSent: Sent. It reaches this wallet within a minute.
chainIdentity.fees.dripAlready: This wallet or its identity already got $fake6529 from 6529.
chainIdentity.fees.dripLimited: Too many requests right now. Try again later.
chainIdentity.fees.dripUnavailable: 6529 can't send $fake6529 right now. Try again later.
chainIdentity.fees.moveBody: Your identity pays the fees for its own changes. Move $fake6529 from this wallet to your identity. The fee for the move comes from this wallet.
chainIdentity.fees.moveInvalid: Enter an amount this wallet holds.
chainIdentity.profile.heading: Profile
chainIdentity.profile.body: Saving stores your profile as a document with 6529's gateway and records it on the 6529 Network. Without a key on this browser, your wallet signs twice: the profile, then the change.
chainIdentity.profile.unreadable: Your current profile document couldn't be read. Saving replaces it with these fields.
chainIdentity.profile.readError: Your current profile couldn't be read, so it can't be changed yet. Try again in a minute.
chainIdentity.profile.readErrorImport: The 6529 Network is still importing identities. You can change your profile once that is done.
chainIdentity.profile.readErrorImportedD: Your imported profile isn't in 6529's document store yet, so it can't be changed. Try again later.
chainIdentity.session.heading: Sign on this browser
chainIdentity.session.offBody: Your wallet signs once to give this browser a key for {days} days. With it, this browser signs your REP, NIC and profile changes, with no wallet prompt each time. The key can't be copied out of this browser.
chainIdentity.session.budget: Fees still come from your identity's balance: at most {amount} $fake6529 in all while the key lasts.
chainIdentity.session.onBody: On until {date}. This browser signs your REP, NIC and profile changes without asking your wallet.
chainIdentity.session.unsupported: This browser can't keep a key safely, so your wallet signs each change.
chainIdentity.wallets.heading: Wallets
chainIdentity.wallets.body: Any of these wallets can sign for your identity. Your identity always keeps at least one wallet.
chainIdentity.wallets.removeNote: After this, {wallet} can't join another identity or create one until {date}. It can rejoin yours at any time.
chainIdentity.wallets.removeNoteNoWait: After this, {wallet} no longer signs for your identity.
chainIdentity.wallets.removeSelf: This is the wallet you are using now.
chainIdentity.wallets.addBody: Both wallets sign. This wallet signs first. Then sign in to 6529.io with the new wallet, on this device or another, open this page and sign there. The new wallet has {time} to sign. Add only a wallet you control: it can sign for your identity and remove its other wallets.
chainIdentity.wallets.joinNote: You sign first, with this wallet. Then {wallet} signs.
chainIdentity.wallets.readyMine: That wallet is already in your identity.
chainIdentity.wallets.readyBound: That wallet belongs to another identity. Remove it there first.
chainIdentity.wallets.readyWaiting: That wallet left another identity on {left}. It can join yours after {until}.
chainIdentity.wallets.oneAtATime: The join for {wallet} is still listed above. Withdraw it, or take it off the list once it has ended, to add another wallet.
chainIdentity.wallets.signInFailed: Sign in to 6529.io with this wallet to add a wallet.
chainIdentity.wallets.started: Waiting for {wallet} to sign, until {date}. Sign in to 6529.io with that wallet and open this page.
chainIdentity.wallets.startedSent: Both wallets signed. Waiting for the 6529 Network to add {wallet}.
chainIdentity.wallets.startedFailed: The join didn't go through. {reason} Take it off this list to start again.
chainIdentity.wallets.startedRefused: The join didn't go through, and its fee was still charged to your identity. {reason} Take it off this list to start again.
chainIdentity.wallets.startedSignIn: Sign in to 6529.io with this wallet to see this join.
chainIdentity.wallets.startedUnreachable: Both wallets signed, but 6529.io couldn't reach the 6529 Network.
chainIdentity.wallets.startedGone: This join has ended: it expired, or a wallet withdrew it.
chainIdentity.wallets.startedDropped: The 6529 Network dropped this join before taking it. Take it off this list to start again.
chainIdentity.wallets.startedUnknown: 6529.io can't read this join right now. Reload the page to check again, or take it off this list.
chainIdentity.wallets.withdrawNote: Your signature still works on the 6529 Network until {date}. A wallet that already read it could still finish the join.
chainIdentity.requests.heading: Requests to add this wallet
chainIdentity.requests.body: Sign only if you asked for this from your own identity. Once this wallet joins an identity, its NFTs count toward that identity's TDH, that identity's delegations (where airdrops go, for example) apply to it, and any of that identity's wallets can remove it.
chainIdentity.requests.signIn: Asked to add this wallet to an identity? Sign in to 6529.io with it to see the request.
chainIdentity.requests.from: {identity} asks to add this wallet. Signed by {wallet}. Open until {date}.
chainIdentity.requests.loadError: 6529.io can't list the requests for this wallet right now.
chainIdentity.requests.feeFromIdentity: Fee: at most {amount} $fake6529, from that identity's balance.
chainIdentity.requests.bound: This wallet already belongs to an identity, so it can't join this one.
chainIdentity.requests.waiting: This wallet left another identity on {left}. It can join this one after {until}.
chainIdentity.requests.unreachable: Your signature is saved, but 6529.io couldn't reach the 6529 Network. The wallet that asked can send it again from its identity page.
chainIdentity.requests.feeShortfall: {identity} doesn't have enough $fake6529 for the fee.
chainIdentity.requests.ended: This request has ended. The wallet that asked can send a new one.
chainIdentity.requests.failedInBlock: The join didn't go through, and {identity} paid the fee for it. {reason}
chainIdentity.requests.mustWait: This wallet left another identity too recently to join this one yet.
chainIdentity.requests.full: {identity} has as many wallets as the 6529 Network allows.
chainIdentity.requests.expired: The request expired before it went through.
chainIdentity.requests.notJoin: This request isn't a wallet join this page can check, so it can't be signed here.
chainIdentity.requests.notFromIdentity: The wallet that asked isn't one of {identity}'s wallets, so this request can't be signed.
chainIdentity.delegations.heading: Delegations
chainIdentity.delegations.body: Delegations and the primary address are on the 6529 Network too. Manage them in the Delegation Center.
chainIdentity.action.confirmIdentity: Fee: at most {amount} $fake6529, from your identity's balance.
chainIdentity.action.confirmWallet: Fee: at most {amount} $fake6529, from this wallet's balance.
chainIdentity.action.declined: You declined in your wallet. Nothing changed.
chainIdentity.action.signingDocument: Check your wallet: sign your profile first.
chainIdentity.action.held: Signed. Now the new wallet signs.
chainIdentity.action.failedCharged: The change didn't go through, and its fee was still charged. {reason}
chainIdentity.rating.feeHint: Get $fake6529 for fees on your identity page.
chainIdentity.error.ADDRESS_BOUND: That wallet already belongs to an identity.
chainIdentity.error.BAD_SIGNATURE: The signature doesn't match. Try again.
chainIdentity.error.BAD_WALLET_SIGNATURE: Your wallet returned a signature the 6529 Network can't use. Try again, or use another wallet app.
chainIdentity.error.CLUSTER_BOUND: That wallet already belongs to an identity.
chainIdentity.error.EXPIRED: The change expired before the 6529 Network took it. Try again.
chainIdentity.error.EXPIRED_AT_EXECUTION: The change expired before the 6529 Network took it. Try again.
chainIdentity.error.FEE_ALLOWANCE_SPENT: This identity has reached its fee limit for today. Try again tomorrow.
chainIdentity.error.FEE_UNCOVERED: Not enough $fake6529 to pay the fee.
chainIdentity.error.FEE_UNCOVERED_KEY: This browser's key has used up its fee budget. Turn its key off and on again on your identity page.
chainIdentity.error.FEE_UNCOVERED_LIMIT: Fees rose past the most this change allowed. Try again.
chainIdentity.error.GRANT_LIMIT: Your identity has as many browser keys as the 6529 Network allows. Turn off the key on another browser, or wait until one ends.
chainIdentity.error.GRANT_INACTIVE: This browser's key has ended. Give the browser a new key on your identity page.
chainIdentity.error.GRANT_NOT_LIVE: This browser's key has ended. Give the browser a new key on your identity page.
chainIdentity.error.IDENTITY_FULL: Your identity has as many wallets as the 6529 Network allows. Remove one to add another.
chainIdentity.error.IDENTITY_HELD: This identity is on hold on the 6529 Network and can't change right now. Try again later.
chainIdentity.error.IMPORT_RUNNING: The 6529 Network is still importing identities. Try again once that is done.
chainIdentity.error.KEY_NOT_BOUND: This wallet isn't one of the identity's wallets. Switch to one of its wallets and try again.
chainIdentity.error.KEY_REVOKED: This browser's key was turned off. Give the browser a new key on your identity page.
chainIdentity.error.LAST_WALLET: An identity's last wallet can't be removed.
chainIdentity.error.MEMPOOL_TTL: The change waited too long and expired. Try again.
chainIdentity.error.MERGED: That identity was merged into another one.
chainIdentity.error.NO_RATER_IDENTITY: This wallet has no identity on the 6529 Network yet. Create one on your identity page.
chainIdentity.error.NO_TARGET_IDENTITY: This profile has no identity on the 6529 Network yet, so it can't be rated there.
chainIdentity.error.NO_WALLET: Connect your wallet to rate on the 6529 Network.
chainIdentity.error.NONCE: Another change from this wallet went first. Try again.
chainIdentity.error.NONCE_WINDOW: Too many changes from this wallet are waiting to go through. Wait a minute, then try again.
chainIdentity.error.NOT_YET_VALID: The change isn't valid yet. Try again in a minute.
chainIdentity.error.NOT_DELEGATOR: Only the wallet or identity that set a delegation can revoke it.
chainIdentity.error.NOT_IN_IDENTITY: That wallet isn't in your identity.
chainIdentity.error.OP_NOT_GRANTED: This browser's key can't make this change. Turn its key off on your identity page, and your wallet signs instead.
chainIdentity.error.OVER_GRANT_BUDGET: This browser's budget is used up. Turn its key off and on again on your identity page.
chainIdentity.error.OVER_RATING_BUDGET: That is more than your TDH lets you give.
chainIdentity.error.PENDING_CAP: Too many changes are waiting on the 6529 Network. Try again in a few minutes.
chainIdentity.error.PRINCIPAL_RECONCILIN: The 6529 Network is still updating this identity. Try again in a few minutes.
chainIdentity.error.PRINCIPAL_INACTIVE: This identity isn't active on the 6529 Network, so it can't make changes.
chainIdentity.error.RATING_LIMIT: You have made as many ratings as the 6529 Network allows. Set one of your ratings to 0 to make a new one.
chainIdentity.error.REDUCTION_UNDER_WAY: The 6529 Network is fitting your ratings to your TDH right now. Try again shortly.
chainIdentity.error.REJOIN_WAIT: That wallet left another identity recently. It has to wait before it joins a different identity or creates one.
chainIdentity.error.REPLACEMENT_UNDERPRI: Another change from this wallet is still waiting to go through. Wait a minute, then try again.
chainIdentity.error.SESSION_KEY_LIMIT: Your identity has as many browser keys as the 6529 Network allows. Turn off the key on another browser, or wait until one ends.
chainIdentity.error.SELF_RATING: You can't rate your own identity.
chainIdentity.error.STALE_VERSION: This changed since the page loaded. Reload and try again.
chainIdentity.error.TARGET_INACTIVE: That isn't an active identity on the 6529 Network, so it can't be rated.
chainIdentity.error.TDH_NOT_APPLIED: The 6529 Network hasn't counted any TDH yet. Try again later.
chainIdentity.error.UNDERPRICED: The fee limit is too low for the 6529 Network right now. Try again.
chainIdentity.error.VALIDITY_TOO_LONG: The change was set to last too long. Try again.
chainIdentity.error.WRONG_NETWORK: The gateway drafted this change for another network. Nothing was signed. Reload the page and try again.
chainIdentity.error.WORK_EXHAUSTED: The change needed more processing than it allowed. Try again.
chainIdentity.error.WRONG_WALLET: Switch your wallet app to {wallet} and try again.
chainIdentity.error.refused: The 6529 Network refused this change. Its reason code is {name}. Reload the page and try again.
chainIdentity.error.noGateway: The 6529 Network didn't answer. Try again in a minute.
chainIdentity.error.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
chainIdentity.error.tooLarge: That is too large to save. Make it shorter.
chainIdentity.error.draftMismatch: 6529.io couldn't confirm this change before signing, so nothing was signed. Try again.
chainIdentity.error.notFinalYet: The change was sent but isn't final yet. Check again in a few minutes.
chainIdentity.error.relaySignIn: Sign in to 6529.io with this wallet, then try again.
chainIdentity.error.relayClosed: This request is no longer open: it was withdrawn, it expired, or it already went through.
chainIdentity.error.relayNoNetwork: 6529.io couldn't reach the 6529 Network. Try again in a minute.
chainIdentity.error.relayDown: 6529.io isn't answering right now. Try again in a minute.
chainIdentity.error.busy: The 6529 Network is busy. Try again in a minute.
chainIdentity.chainDelegations.heading: Delegations on the 6529 Network
chainIdentity.chainDelegations.body: 6529 reads delegations from the 6529 Network. Set and revoke them here. Your wallet signs each change.
chainIdentity.chainDelegations.connect: Connect a wallet to see its delegations on the 6529 Network.
chainIdentity.chainDelegations.none: No delegations on the 6529 Network for this wallet.
chainIdentity.chainDelegations.identityS: For your identity (every wallet in it)
chainIdentity.chainDelegations.invalid: Enter a delegate wallet, and a token ID and date where needed.
